tools.name: guardian.status
tools.description: Guardian liveness, memory pressure, and last-sweep summary. Read-only.

tools.name: guardian.census
tools.description: Process-family summary of the current census (counts + notable outliers). Read-only, no mutations.

tools.name: guardian.sweep
tools.description: Run one guardian sweep. Dry-run by default: decisions are computed but nothing is signaled. Executing kills requires dry_run=false and acts only on recoverable, on-demand-respawn helpers — user applications are structural never-touch.

dry_run.description: When false, decisions are executed (SIGTERM, SIGKILL after grace).
